Stock market news | Bank Nifty crashes 2,000 points, 3.1% drop

On 23 November 2026 the Bank Nifty index dropped more than 2,000 points, ending about 3% below its prior close.
The sharp fall hit major banks such as HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank and State Bank of India, signaling pressure on the banking sector.
